where: Sunvault Climb I & II (golden vine terraces up to Nightreach) + the Sunfall vigil site
mood: Vines to the Sky: warm, ascending, hopeful - every phrase climbs like the terraces; the sunniest route in the West.
core_styles: bright round brass-like pulse-wave lead playing an ascending broken-chord melody that steps higher each phrase
fast shimmering harp arpeggios rolling upward
brisk steady kick, snare and hi-hat walking groove
warm, hopeful, climbing adventure route theme

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a bold call to climb: a drum pickup and an upward arpeggiated fanfare launching from low to high, each rung a step higher, landing on a bright chord that drives into the theme}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the climbing melody: a springy arpeggiated launch repeated a step higher each phrase, hummable and confident, bass walking}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the melody again with a bell counter-line sparkling above and the strings fuller, climbing higher still}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: a breather on a sunny terrace - B minor and G major, a lyrical singing line over gentle harp, drums light, golden and wondering, then a rising drum fill back to the climb}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the climbing theme returns in full stride; the last bar leads straight back into the main theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
